This is my little gallery of records, the best performaces for every combination of race type and distance.
:::

::: {.utility-panel}

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(arrow)
library(hms)
library(stringr)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(glue)


# Connect to DuckDB
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  
# Enable HTTPFS extension to access remote files
invisible(dbExecute(con, "INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;"))
invisible(dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA disable_object_cache"))

cache_bust <- as.integer(Sys.time())

races_metadata_url <- paste0(
  "https://storage.googleapis.com/blogs_josa/sport/parquets/races_metadata.parquet",
  "?cache_bust=",
  cache_bust
)

races_rankings_url <- paste0(
  "https://storage.googleapis.com/blogs_josa/sport/parquets/races_rankings.parquet",
  "?cache_bust=",
  cache_bust
)
  
race_metadata <- dbGetQuery(con, 
                            glue("SELECT EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_DISTANCE, EVENT_NAME, RACE_ID, POINT_FLAG
  FROM read_parquet('{races_metadata_url}')"))
  


main <- race_metadata |>
  mutate(typeIs = paste0(EVENT_TYPE, " - ", EVENT_DISTANCE)) |>
  filter(typeIs %in% toupper(c(
    "aquathlon - 1K/7.5K", "aquathlon - 450m/5K", "aquathlon - 500m/5K",
    "aquathlon - 750m/5K", "aquathlon - 810m/7.5K", "bike - 135K", "bike - 160K",
    "bike - 16K", "run - 10K",
    "run - 21.1K", "run - 42.2K", "run - 5K", "run - 5miles", 
    "sprint duathlon - 5K/20K/2.5K", "sprint triathlon - 420m/16K/5K",
    "sprint triathlon - 420m/20K/5K", "sprint triathlon - 750m/20K/5K",
    "sprint triathlon - 750m/30K/7.5K", "standard triathlon - 1500m/40K/10K",
    "swim - 1500m", "swim - 3K", "triathlon - 2000m/82K/16K", "indoor triathlon - 15min/15min/15min"))) |>
  select(all_of(c(
    'RACE_ID',
    'EVENT_DISTANCE',
    'EVENT_NAME',
    'EVENT_TYPE',
    'POINT_FLAG'
  )))

race_ids <- paste0("'", paste0(main$RACE_ID, collapse = "', '"), "'")

rankings <- dbGetQuery(con, 
                            glue("SELECT RACE_ID, RESULT_FINAL, RANKING_CATEGORY, RANKING_GENDER, RANKING_OVERALL
  FROM read_parquet('{races_rankings_url}')
  WHERE ATHLETE IN ('ADRIAN JOSEPH') AND
    RACE_ID IN ({race_ids})"))
  
results <- rankings |>
  left_join(main, by = 'RACE_ID') |>
  group_by(EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_DISTANCE) |>
  group_modify(\(.x, .y) {
    valid_rows <- .x |>
      filter(!is.na(RESULT_FINAL), RESULT_FINAL > 0)

    if (nrow(valid_rows) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        event_name = NA_character_,
        fastest_time = NA_character_
      ))
    }

    point_flag <- unique(valid_rows$POINT_FLAG)
    best_index <- if (isTRUE(point_flag)) {
      which.max(valid_rows$RESULT_FINAL)[1]
    } else {
      which.min(valid_rows$RESULT_FINAL)[1]
    }

    fastest_value <- valid_rows$RESULT_FINAL[best_index]
    fastest_label <- if (isTRUE(point_flag)) {
      as.character(fastest_value)
    } else {
      as.character(hms::as_hms(fastest_value))
    }

    fastest_race_id <- valid_rows$RACE_ID[best_index]
    fastest_event_name <- valid_rows$EVENT_NAME[best_index]
    fastest_link <- paste0(
      "https://asjblog.shinyapps.io/single_race_viewer/?_inputs_&selector=%22",
      gsub(" ", "%20", fastest_race_id),
      "%22"
    )

    tibble(
      event_name = paste0(
        '<a href="', fastest_link, '" target="_blank">',
        fastest_event_name,
        '</a>'
      ),
      fastest_time = fastest_label
    )
  }) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_DISTANCE) |>
  select(EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_DISTANCE, event_name, fastest_time)


colnames(results) <- stringr::str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", colnames(results)))



DT::datatable(results,
              rownames = FALSE,
              filter = 'top',
              selection = 'single',
              escape = FALSE,
              options = list(
                paging =TRUE,
                pageLength =  30
              ))
```
